title: Gotrade Daily: Oil Near $100 & the Fed Puzzle
summary: Oil nears $100 and US inflation data tests the Fed's path. Here's the energy-and-chip watchlist for tonight's US session: OXY, XOM, NVDA, AMD, AVGO.
body_markdown:
## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[OXY](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/oxy/) Early pre-market around -0.8% (profit-taking) Direct beneficiary of the oil surge; named explicitly in coverage as the energy play


[XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) Tracking the oil move Energy is the most sensitive sector if Brent holds above $98


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Slightly higher pre-market; chips a bright spot Goldman Sachs conference presentation Sep 10 and a $0.25 dividend ex-date on Sep 10


[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) Riding the semiconductor rally AI chip-demand sentiment still firm; a gauge of risk appetite tonight


[AVGO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/avgo/) Choppy; the "buy the dip" debate Slipped recently; the market is weighing whether the pullback is an opportunity or a pause in the AI rally


## Tonight's Catalysts


### Oil near $100 and the energy sector


Oil pushed to a six-week high after a strike on a Saudi facility, with Iran-US tensions adding a risk premium. **Occidental ([OXY](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/oxy/) )** and **ExxonMobil ([XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) )** are the names most tied to this theme.


### US inflation data and the Fed's path


Gold dropped ahead of the US inflation release, a signal the market is recalculating the rate path. The oil spike briefly lifted rate-hike bets, but those odds swung back toward a coin-flip after more dovish commentary from a Fed official. Tonight's inflation data is the tiebreaker, and rate-sensitive tech is the most exposed.


### The AI chip rally gets tested


Semiconductors are the bright spot offsetting pressure from oil. **AMD ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** and **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** are firmer, while **Broadcom ([AVGO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/avgo/) )** has been choppier. The market is weighing whether Broadcom's weakness is a buying opportunity or a sign the rally is losing steam.
